name: Swaraga Raga Classifier Agent
description: Autonomous Agent Card for Swaraga — classify Hindustani and Carnatic ragas from vocal audio via 12-swarasthana YIN pitch telemetry and TypeSafe System One (Jev) / OpenJev WASM.

tools.name: list_ragas
tools.description: Return the 12 canonical Hindustani and Carnatic ragas, swarasthanas, parent Thaats, Vadi/Samvadi, and Pakad motifs.

thaat.description: Optional parent Thaat filter (e.g. Kalyan, Bhairav, Asavari)

tools.name: classify_sample_raga
tools.description: Classify one of the 6 reference vocal recordings (yaman, bhairav, bhupali, malkauns, darbari_kanada, hamsadhwani) and return its telemetry and System One probabilities.

ragaId.description: Sample raga ID to classify (e.g. yaman, bhairav, malkauns)
